name: only-protected-zones-chooses-rsu
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. A roadside-unit CAM whose entity holds, of the two HighFrequencyContainer alternatives, only etsicam.protected_zones (one zone, type permanentCenDsrcTolling, no OPTIONAL component: presence 000). Encode writes alt 1: the defaults of alt 0 are not content (0.19, CHOICE; rulings 3 and 19 of 0.19). Were they content, alt 0 would be written and the bytes would differ from bit 199. 275 bits, padded to 35 octets. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
